articles.title: This Suitcase-Sized Spacecraft Will Listen for the Universe's First Light
articles.summary: A tiny spacecraft called CosmoCube will orbit the Moon to catch a faint radio signal from before the first stars existed — a period of cosmic darkness no one has ever directly observed.

articles.title: Earth Just Got a Health Check — and 7 of 9 Life-Support Systems Are in Trouble
articles.summary: A new report says seven of Earth's nine planetary boundaries — the systems that keep our planet stable — have been breached. But scientists say we still have a chance to fix things if we act fast.

articles.title: Shark Teeth Found in the Desert!
articles.summary: Scientists found 14 shark teeth in Egypt's desert. They're 70 to 80 million years old! Long ago, that dry land was a warm sea full of sharks.
